# Python implementation of the FEAL cipher (mirrors feal.c / decrypt.c)
M32 = 0xFFFFFFFF

def g(a, b, x):
    t = (a + b + x) & 0xFF
    return ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF

def F(v):
    x = [(v >> (8*i)) & 0xFF for i in range(4)]
    y2 = g(x[3] ^ x[2], x[1] ^ x[0], 1)
    y3 = g(x[3], y2, 0)
    y1 = g(x[1] ^ x[0], y2, 0)
    y0 = g(x[0], y1, 1)
    return y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)

def expand(k):
    return (k ^ ((k << 16) & M32) ^ (k * 12345)) & M32

def set_keys(seeds):
    return [expand(s & 0xFFFFF) for s in seeds]

def encrypt(p, keys):
    left = (p >> 32) & M32
    right = p & M32
    right ^= left
    for r in range(4):
        mixed = F((right ^ keys[r]) & M32)
        left, right = right, (left ^ mixed) & M32
    left ^= right
    return ((left & M32) << 32) | (right & M32)

def decrypt(c, keys):
    left = c & M32          # getright
    right = (c >> 32) & M32 # getleft
    left ^= right
    for r in range(3, -1, -1):
        temp = left
        left = right
        mixed = F((temp ^ keys[r]) & M32)
        right = temp
        left ^= mixed
    right ^= left
    return ((left & M32) << 32) | (right & M32)
